title: Puzzle Solver (Coding)
description:
Puzzle Solver (Coding)
Pay: $50-$80/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired
We are looking for highly skilled coding puzzle solvers to contribute to an AI training project involving algorithmic reasoning, debugging, constrained technical problems, and reproducible software solutions.
The work involves solving self-contained coding and technical challenges designed to test the capabilities of advanced AI models. A representative task may require exploring an unfamiliar codebase or terminal environment, understanding a precise objective, implementing a solution, testing it against hidden or explicit constraints, and producing a reproducible final result.
What You’ll Work On

• Solve self-contained coding, logic, debugging, and technical reasoning challenges.

• Analyze unfamiliar problems and translate their requirements into implementable solutions.

• Select appropriate algorithms, data structures, and problem-solving strategies.

• Work inside terminal-based development environments and existing codebases.

• Implement correct and efficient solutions using an appropriate programming language.

• Identify ambiguous requirements, edge cases, hidden assumptions, and failure conditions.

• Debug incorrect behavior across code, tests, dependencies, and environment configuration.

• Develop tests and verification methods that distinguish genuinely correct solutions from superficially plausible ones.

• Review AI-generated solutions and identify logic errors, incomplete reasoning, and constraint violations.

• Produce clear, reproducible solutions that can be executed and evaluated automatically.

• Explain reasoning, implementation decisions, and trade-offs clearly

Required Qualifications

• Strong algorithmic problem-solving ability.

• Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as C++, Python, Java, Rust, Go, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript .

• Strong understanding of common data structures and algorithms.

• Ability to reason carefully about constraints, complexity, edge cases, and correctness.

• Experience debugging unfamiliar code or solving technically ambiguous problems.

• Ability to work independently in terminal-based development environments.

• Ability to produce reproducible, testable software solutions.

• Clear written and verbal technical communication.

A public or otherwise verifiable Codeforces profile demonstrating meaningful competitive-programming experience is nice to have.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete a technical assessment, if required.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply.
Start Timeline & Availability

• We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

As part of New York Life’s Group Membership Association Division, you'll be working with the nation’s No. 1 provider of life and disability income insurance solutions for association/affinity programs. Beyond the tailored life and disability income insurance solutions you provide, your work fosters a sense of community and shared support within affinity groups.

Role Overview

Reporting to the Team Manager, the Medical Underwriter, Sr. Associate is responsible for evaluating life insurance applications and determining whether applications should be approved, declined or if additional information is required. The Medical Underwriter is authorized to issue or decline all cases within their authority limit.

The Medical Underwriter, Sr. Associate predominately relies on Underwriting Guidelines to evaluate an applicant's risk classification; however, due to the complexity associated with multiple conditions or the diversity of conditions identified within an Attending Physician Statement, they are frequently required to make assessments of applicant risk absent specific direction from the Underwriting Guidelines. Whether synthesizing the mortality risk of medical labs and family history or discounting the mortality risks of highly correlated factors such as motor vehicle reports and avocations, Senior Associates are expected to evaluate an applicant's overall risk profile, not simply summing the total from the individual risk factors. Technical leads, Medical Directors and Team Underwriters are available for consult as necessary; but the Medical Underwriter, Sr. Associates are expected to make a decision recommendation, not open-ended requests for insight. As the majority of applications reviewed by this role include Attending Physician Statements, a Sr. Associate must have a working knowledge of medical terminology and awareness of how various medical impairments interact and effect individual mortality and morbidity risk. Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

Why Join Our Engineering Team?

Freetrade Engineers play a pivotal role in developing and maintaining a robust, scalable platform used by thousands daily. We tackle big technical challenges, drive innovation, and build solutions that make a real impact.

Here, your code doesn’t just run - it powers the decisions of investors across the UK.

About the role

As part of our dedicated mobile engineering team, you will work on implementing new features. In collaboration with design, product and QE teams you will craft user experiences that will delight our customers.

You will also help guide priorities around platform issues, technical debt, patterns, and architecture, ensuring we deliver a high-quality app and an excellent developer experience.

We have recently rebranded key parts of the app, creating a new design system from scratch built with Swift UI, and have started transitioning to a modern, unified GraphQL API using Apollo.

What you’ll do

- Lead the design and delivery of new features, alongside improving and maintaining the Freetrade iOS app, ensuring high performance, quality, security and robustness.

- Own features end to end, collaborating with backend, design, product and QE to deliver high-quality solutions.

- Set and hold a high bar for code quality through hands-on development, code reviews and effective testing.

- Resolve complex issues, address bottlenecks and reduce technical debt.

- Drive improvements in engineering standards and practices.

- Mentor and support junior engineers on design, implementation and best practices.

- Participate in a support rota to understand and resolve customer issues, including direct communication where needed.

About you

- Typically 6+ years of experience building production-grade mobile applications.

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to lead technical decisions and deliver complex features.

- Deep understanding of iOS architecture and common patterns

- Strong experience with Swift, DI frameworks, and SwiftUI.

- Good understanding of GraphQL and integrating with backend services.

- Experience with Combine, Swift Concurrency or RxSwift.

- Familiarity with git and collaborative development practices.

- Understanding of CI and build tooling such as CircleCI.

- Experience mentoring and growing more junior engineers.

Our hybrid model

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration to build a strong culture, but we know "life happens." If you have caregiving or personal responsibilities that require extra flexibility, let’s talk about it.

Our interview process

We keep things simple and transparent. You’ll meet one of our Talent Partners for a technical screening call, typically followed by:

1. Hiring Manager interview

2. Live coding interview

3. System design interview

4. Values interview

• Patient requests are documented and routed correctly.

• Scheduling follows the clinic's triage protocols.

• No important task or patient concern is dropped.

• Answer inbound patient calls professionally and return missed calls or voicemails promptly.

title: IT Systems Administrator

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring an IT Systems Administrator to join the founding IT team in San Francisco. You'll run most of our SaaS stack day to day, from maintenance and configuration changes to access and troubleshooting. You'll also build the automation that keeps that stack running as we grow.

This is a role for someone who does a bit of everything: helping an employee that’s locked out, shipping a terraform change, and building an automation that removes a manual task. The ideal candidate has startup experience, is comfortable with ambiguity, and heavily leans into automation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration or IT engineering, ideally at a fast-growing startup

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

 As we continue to expand our operations across India, one of the fastest-growing bus markets in the world, we are looking for a proactive & detail-oriented Traffic Control Executive for our Bangalore location who will help us keep our services running smoothly, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success.

This is a real-time operations role, where you will be responsible for overseeing live bus operations, ensuring seamless coordination between drivers, hosts, and internal teams, and managing crisis situations calmly in a fast-paced environment. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of Flix's services, including real-time monitoring, issue resolution, and cross-team coordination!

About The Role

• Communicate with drivers and hosts via calls and messages to ensure smooth, on-time operations.

• Track and manage operational issues through Salesforce tickets, ensuring timely resolution.

• Handle crisis situations swiftly and decisively to minimize disruption to passengers and partners.

• Coordinate with Operations, Customer Support, and Global teams for end-to-end issue resolution.

• Collaborate via MS Teams and chat to enable seamless, real-time communication across teams.

• Monitor live operations and escalate deviations or incidents to the relevant stakeholders.

• Maintain discipline, flexibility, and teamwork while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

About You

• Bachelor's degree holder, preferably with 3+ years' hands-on experience in customer service, intercity travel operations, or a related field.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills and effective communication skills.

• Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and stay composed under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment; flexible to work 24/7 rotational shifts, including weekends. However, when schedules are made your personal needs are taken into consideration.

• Basic Excel proficiency; experience with Salesforce is a strong plus.

• You are fluent in Telugu and English. Additional South Indian languages and Hindi are a plus.

• You are communicative, proactive, detail-oriented, and a dependable team player.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up.

Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, real-time issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Here’s what this particular role covers.

The Vehicle Modelling team at Wayve builds virtual vehicle models that directly improve simulation accuracy and how well our cars drive. The team's output feeds simulation, evaluation tools, fleet-wide metrics, and future commercial partnerships, giving it impact across the whole company. We're integrating vehicle models with advanced modelling technologies, building what is becoming the go-to tool for simulation and evaluation at Wayve.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Develop virtual vehicle models using physics-based and data-driven techniques

- Validate models against on-road data and implement correlation improvements

- Convert models into efficient, high-quality software components that meet accuracy, performance, and scalability requirements

- Room to specialise over time, whether that's pure modelling, correlation/metrics, or experimental track work, as the team scales

- You've validated simulation models against experimental data, and know what "good enough" looks like

- Confident writing production-quality code in C++ or Python

- Bring previous experience in vehicle dynamics for autonomous vehicles, automotive, or motorsport

- Comfortable with data-driven approaches, such as machine learning or system identification, for modelling systems with unknown physical parameters

- Know your way around high-fidelity vehicle dynamics tools (e.g. Dymola, CarSim, CarMaker) and how to integrate them into simulation workflows

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Overview
The MRO Advisory Solutions team is expanding beyond its current assessment offerings into performance improvement and analytics consulting. The Consultant role owns the analytical and project execution core of new advisory offerings: the data collection and analysis, the deliverables, the workplan, and the day-to-day partner engagement that makes each engagement land.
These offerings are new and pre-launch. That makes this a build role as much as a delivery role: the Consultant executes the pilots, instruments them against defined success criteria, brings back structured evidence about what should change, and helps convert what works into repeatable delivery assets so each offering can scale past its first few partners.
Responsibilities
1. Analysis and Deliverables · ~45%
Owns the analytical core of every engagement - the Collect and Analyze phases, and the authorship of key deliverables.

• Assemble and validate the engagement data set: this could include registry data (STS Adult Cardiac Surgery, NCDR CathPCI, TVT; NAACCR for oncology), read-only EMR review, Market Analytics, benchmark data, and partner-supplied operational and financial data

• Run the quantitative analysis each offering requires - this could include things like outcomes, length-of-stay, and adverse event variation; physician-level variation and documentation gaps; performance against public benchmarks; patient migration and leakage; competitive and market position

• Build the financial impact analysis: ROI and cost-impact modeling, revenue sizing, and growth opportunities

• Conduct the qualitative work - stakeholder interviews, surveys, and workflow review - and synthesize it against the quantitative findings

title: Customer Transformation Specialist
description:
Why this role exists
We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work-whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction.
Role Overview
We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.'
Transactions at Koronet

Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'-we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone.
What you will do

• Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction.

• Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes.

• Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues.

• Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet.

• Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection.

• Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress.

• Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy.

How you will work with other departments

• CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks."

• Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development.

• Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting.

• Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations.

What success looks like

• Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem

• The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning.

• Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell.

• The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better.

A few things this role isn't!

• A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation.

• A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up.

• A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity.

• A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team.

What do we expect from you

• Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation.

• Fluent in English (must).

• Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations.

• Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives.

• Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations.

• Has strong organizing skills.

• Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first.

• Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus.

What We Offer:

• An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.

• Flexible / Remote working environment.

• We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.

Why Join Koronet :

• Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.

• Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.

• Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.

• Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience.

If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

title: Director - Post-Silicon Validation (Functional)
description:
Graphcore

Director-Post Silicon Validation (Functional)

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.  

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Austin, Texas which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing.  

We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. 

 

Job Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, cross-functional development team validating cutting-edge, high-performance AI chips and platforms.

You will play a key role in supporting new product introductions and validation. You will lead a team delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.

Working within the Validation team, you will be involved with bringing first silicon to life, functionally validating it and working closely with many other teams to help it become a fully   characterised   and working product, reporting project status/progress to program management on a regular basis. You will have the opportunity to provide technical guidance to other engineering team members. In this role, you can leverage our experience and industry knowledge to architect and drive implementation of continuous improvements to test infrastructure and processes.

 

The Team

The Post-Silicon   Bringup   team sits within the Architecture and Validation team, we are responsible for   bringup   and validation of new silicon when it returns from manufacture, enabling and supporting the production SW and FW teams to bring up their software and supporting the Silicon Characterisation team.

 

Responsibilities and Duties:

•   Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation tests in bare metal C/C++ on FPGA/Emulator prior to first silicon

•   Deploy silicon validation tests on first silicon and debugging them

•   Develop automated test framework and regression test suites in Python to optimize validation efficiency

•   Collaborate closely with engineers from many other disciplines on a variety of topics

•   Work with Validation and Production Test engineering peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to test methodologies

•   Analyse test results, identify and debug failures/defects

•   Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure

•   Provide feedback to architects  

 

Minimum Qualifications:

•   Understanding of ML applications and their workloads

•   A self-starter who can apply independent judgement

•   A team player able to lead and support colleagues with difficult concepts

•   Strong experience in Bare metal / embedded C/C++

•   Excellent problem-solving, analytical & diagnostic skills

•   Ability to work across teams and programming languages to find root causes of critical and complex issues

•   Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments

•   Python, Linux

•   Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain difficult concepts to resolve issues 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

•   10+   years  experience  

•   Experience building and leading, multi-site team

title: Incubation Research Specialist II
description:
As an Incubation Research Specialist II , you'll join a newly established research and incubation capability within Global Program, helping transform emerging ideas into evidence-based solutions that improve outcomes for children, youth, families, and churches around the world. Incubation is how Compassion explores unmet needs, develops promising concepts, rigorously tests them in real-world settings, and determines whether they should be expanded for greater impact.
This is not a traditional research role. You'll work at the intersection of innovation, strategy, and practical ministry application, partnering with diverse stakeholders across the globe to explore complex questions, facilitate meaningful conversations, and evaluate new approaches that could shape the future of child development programming.

If you are curious, collaborative, energized by ambiguity, and passionate about using research to drive meaningful change, this role offers a unique opportunity to influence Compassion's future while advancing its mission to release children from poverty in Jesus' name.

This position may be filled at either the Level II or Level III based on the selected candidate's experience, skills, and demonstrated competencies.

What will you do?

• Maintain a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ, maintains a courteous, Christ-like attitude in dealing with people within and outside of Compassion, and faithfully upholds Compassion's ministry in prayer.

• Act as an advocate to raise the awareness of the needs of children. Understand Christ's mandate to protect children. Commit to and prioritize child protection considerations in all decision-making, tasks and activities across the ministry. Abide by all behavioral expectations in Compassion's Statement of Commitment to Child Protection and Code of Conduct. Report any concerns of abuse, neglect or exploitation of children through Compassion's internal reporting process and appropriately support responses to incidents if they occur.

• Support the design, development, and implementation of incubation and research initiatives that address complex challenges facing children, youth, families, churches, and field offices.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to identify unmet needs, generate new ideas, and evaluate their potential effectiveness, sustainability, and scalability.

• Explore and apply appropriate research methods to answer key learning questions and assess the impact of pilot initiatives.

• Facilitate workshops, discussions, and stakeholder engagement sessions that bring together diverse perspectives and foster collaborative problem-solving.

• Analyze and synthesize research findings, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support projects from concept development through testing and evaluation, helping determine whether an approach should be refined, expanded, or concluded.

• Contribute to learning agendas that strengthen Compassion's ability to innovate responsibly and effectively.

• Balance and integrate feedback from multiple stakeholders, including children, youth, church partners, field leaders, researchers, and organizational leadership.

• Stay informed on emerging research, development trends, and innovative practices relevant to child development and poverty alleviation.

•
Travel globally (up to 30%) to support project implementation, stakeholder engagement, and learning activities as needed.

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description: The Opportunity Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin. The Role You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails. What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules. By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release. title: Sales Manager, Wolt for Work
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, you can grow your sales career with a fun and fast-scaling global business. Part of the DoorDash team, we're building a global logistics platform that can deliver (almost) everything in your city, to your door in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who can now order from 200,000+ restaurants and retail stores across 30+ countries around the world.

Wolt for Work is a rapidly growing B2B business at Wolt, and we have ambitious plans to massively accelerate this growth. Our mission is simple: we want to bring the same great user experience that Wolt is known for to business users around the world. Through Wolt's established delivery network and vast number of restaurant and retail partners, Wolt for Work enables businesses to boost their employees' happiness no matter where they are working, promote camaraderie in teams, and save time and effort running office events. We are already in 21 countries, with no plans to slow down.

We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to grow Wolt for Work in Poland. You’ll combine new business development with account management: winning new corporate clients and helping existing customers grow their use of Wolt for Work. Your portfolio will span startups, SMBs, and large enterprises.

What you'll be doing

Success in this role means:
